name: lapl-birth-support
description: Read-only calculator for Korean childbirth and child-rearing support money by region, birth order and child age, from LAPL.

interface.longDescription:
Read-only connector from LAPL, a Korean parenting information service. It tells parents which childbirth and child-rearing support programs and amounts they can receive in Korea, based only on region (province and city/district), birth order and the age of the child in months. No personal information is entered and no account is needed. Tools: plan_birth_support (personalized calculation by region, birth order and child age), get_support_programs (central, provincial and city/district programs with how to apply and official Bokjiro links) and list_regions (supported region names). Amounts come from a single verified LAPL amount table based on official Ministry of Health and Welfare (Bokjiro) data; if verification fails the tool returns no figure instead of guessing. Information is for reference; final eligibility is decided by the local government.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.0 First public release. 3 read-only tools (plan_birth_support, get_support_programs, list_regions) for Korean childbirth and child-rearing support by region, birth order and child age. No authentication, no personal data, no advertising. Rate limit 40 requests per minute per IP.
